title: The Fox and the Crow
plan_warnings: Paragraphs 3 to 8 are almost continuous speech (no pause of 0.6 s after 42.7 s), so nearly all sound effects sit in the first 43 s and at the very end. Do not add effects under the words.

This is a talking story: two characters stand still for two minutes. The plan keeps it moving with three story clouds, the heart, the shadow and the gap; if the clouds are cut or simplified the film will go static.
S6 packs a whole inset story into 8.5 s (73.8-82.3); it must be staged very simply (one floor line, left to right) or it will not read on a phone.
The hawk kind, rat and insect are planned by other stories but not in the Library yet; if they are built first elsewhere, use those drawings and names.
The crane in S1 passes 1060 world units in 2.5 s; keep the rock face detail sparse so it does not strobe at 30 fps.
Time of day moves from morning to dusk across one conversation; this is a mood device, not narrated. The single LATER card is at 160.75-161.55 over the words 'then he returned'.
